From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From tri- +‎ -ciclo.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /triˈt͡ʃi.klo/
  • Rhymes: -iklo
  • Hyphenation: tri‧cì‧clo
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

triciclo m (plural tricicli)

  1. tricycle (cycle with three wheels)

Further reading

[edit]
  • triciclo in Collins Italian-English Dictionary
  • triciclo in Aldo Gabrielli, Grandi Dizionario Italiano (Hoepli)
  • triciclo in garzantilinguistica.it – Garzanti Linguistica, De Agostini Scuola Spa
  • tricìclo in Dizionario Italiano Olivetti, Olivetti Media Communication
  • triciclo in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

Anagrams

[edit]
  • coltrici

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From tri- +‎ -ciclo.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /tɾiˈsi.klu/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /tɾiˈsi.klu/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /tɾiˈsi.klo/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /tɾiˈsi.klu/

  • Hyphenation: tri‧ci‧clo

Noun

[edit]

triciclo m (plural triciclos)

  1. tricycle (cycle with three wheels)

Further reading

[edit]
  • “triciclo”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “triciclo”, in Dicionário inFormal (in Portuguese), 2006–2026

  • “triciclo”, in Dicionário infopédia da Lingua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Porto: Porto Editora, 2003–2026
  • “triciclo”, in Michaelis Dicionário Brasileiro da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), São Paulo: Editora Melhoramentos, 2015–2026, →ISBN

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From tri- +‎ -ciclo.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /tɾiˈθiklo/ [t̪ɾiˈθi.klo] (Spain, Equatorial Guinea)
  • IPA(key): /tɾiˈsiklo/ [t̪ɾiˈsi.klo] (Latin America, Philippines)
  • Rhymes: -iklo
  • Syllabification: tri‧ci‧clo

Noun

[edit]

triciclo m (plural triciclos)

  1. tricycle (bicycle with three wheels)
  2. any three-wheeled vehicle
  3. (Philippines) autorickshaw; motorized cycle rickshaw (usually a roofed motorcycle with sidecar, often available for hire in the manner of a taxi)

Further reading

[edit]
  • “triciclo”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
